name: Pimsleur
tagline: Pimsleur is a language learning program based on the scientifically developed Pimsleur method, which uses spaced repetition audio lessons to build conversational fluency. Its app delivers 30-minute daily spoken language sessions for over 50 languages with AI-driven pronunciation feedback.
